benchmark_price.notes: Official closing price via stockanalysis.com for the last completed trading session. Benchmark-only input; does not drive DCF cash flows, share issuance, or intrinsic value.

terminal_stage.description: Gordon growth on normalised steady-state FCFF

enterprise_relative.weight: Single cluster observation by internal majority vote

evidence_clusters.collapse_rule: Multiple methods within a cluster collapse to one breadth observation by majority vote within the cluster. Verdict ordering: overvalued < fair < undervalued; exact ties keep weaker (minimum) verdict. Final verdict: 3/3 agree -> that verdict; 2/3 agree -> majority verdict; otherwise -> fair (HOLD). Max 3 breadth observations.
evidence_clusters.fcfe_role: Diagnostic reconciliation check only (FCFE - FCFF = after-tax interest income). Never a floor, range endpoint, recommendation, or vote.
evidence_clusters.sotp_role: Optional segment decomposition only under EV/Revenue. Receives zero vote while duplicating EV/Revenue.

forecast_periods.legacy_five_year_comparison: Legacy 5-year comparison path retained for explicit disclosure only; cannot control production relative values or release outputs.

share_issuance_policy.dcf_dilution_modeling: Modeled exactly once. DCF reports current-share value and canonical value after modeled future dilution.

perpetual_dilution_rate.rule: shares_{t+1} = shares_t * (1 + d_perm); positivity: (1 + d_perm) > 0 and (ke - d_perm) > 0

share_issuance_policy.sbc_addback: SBC added back to GAAP operating cash flow.

sbc_issuance_price.notes: Separate frozen issuance price for dilution sensitivities; decoupled from mutable market benchmark price.

current_fully_diluted_shares.basis: Point-in-time fully diluted share schedule at 2026-06-30, read from the cited Form 10-Q (accession 0001628280-26-053603, filed 2026-08-06): basic period-end 46,724,000 (Class A 40,325,000 outstanding + Class B 6,399,000 outstanding) plus incremental options 520,458 (treasury stock method on 636,000 options at a $21.09 weighted-average exercise price against a $116.09 method price derived from the filing own aggregate intrinsic value) plus RSUs and other awards 2,817,000 plus founder awards 0 (performance conditions not met at the measurement date; 720,000 in the comparable prior-year quarter).
current_fully_diluted_shares.role: Production denominator for all present-day relative valuation methods (EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDAR, P/FCF, SOTP decomposition, Per-User). Never uses the DCF terminal share roll.

supersedes.basis: P10.0 approximation (~50.7m with basic 46,786,269, derived from 40,387,012 Class A issued rather than the 40,325,000 Class A outstanding, and before options, RSUs and awards were built out to a single reconciled schedule).
supersedes.note: The P10.0 baseline manifest remains the point-in-time record of that phase. This context document is the living contract and now carries the ruled schedule.

current_fully_diluted_shares.issuerCrossCheck: The issuer own Q2 FY2026 dilutive components (519 options + 2,817 RSUs + 0 founder awards = 3,336) equal exactly the 50,031 diluted-less-46,695 basic weighted-average spread, and the point-in-time treasury-stock-method increment of 520,458 lands within 0.3% of the issuer 519,000.

weighted_average_diluted_shares.role: EPS diagnostic only. Must not be used as a valuation denominator.
